description.en:
Server Journal is a multiplayer bulletin board system for Farming Simulator 25. Players can view real-time announcements, create posts for jobs, freight, sales, and RP. All data is server-authoritative and persists in the savegame.
Features: - Real-time post creation and listing - Category filters (Job, Sale, Freight, RP) - Full multiplayer synchronization - Savegame persistence - Native GIANTS Engine UI
Author: B.O.B Version: 1.0.9.0 Category: Gameplay / HUD
